source: Verified public About, Contact, Services, Products, Quality and Export pages. Shared catalogue data is added at runtime.

founder.name: Prakash Mewada
founder.biography: Founder of PanVibes Exim Pvt Ltd and Gaamup Infra. Experience in construction, manufacturing and supply-chain operations. His work at PanVibes focuses on ethical sourcing, transparency, quality and long-term trade partnerships.

business: B2B sourcing and export-import support based in Navi Mumbai, India, connecting Indian suppliers with business buyers. Food ingredients, nutrition ingredients and a separate industrial chemicals portfolio.

enquiries.process: Use an Enquiry button to open the form on the current page. Successful submissions are stored in a private SQLite database and return a PV reference. A server-side notification is sent to the PanVibes team through Google SMTP. If email delivery fails, the enquiry remains stored for administrator follow-up and retry. The visitor may also open an optional email summary.
requiredInformation: Delivery country and city for Europe
enquiries.confirmation: Prices, MOQ, stock, lead time, sample charges and delivery eligibility require the team’s confirmation. The chatbot cannot submit enquiries or access private customer records.
enquiries.quantityHint: The quantity field displays MOQ 50 kgs. Confirm final product-specific commercial terms with the team.
enquiries.otherDestination: The form accepts Any other with a delivery country/city for review; this does not extend the five confirmed shipping markets.

quality.guidance: Request product specifications, COA, laboratory reports or SDS/MSDS as applicable. Availability and exact product/lot scope are confirmed by the team. Organic certificates must be verified for the product and lot; listing a grade does not establish certification.

shippingPolicy: Only India, the UK, the USA, Europe and the UAE. For Europe request the specific country and city. No worldwide delivery promise.
currentCatalogueRestrictions: Nutraceuticals: only Moringa Powder and Ashwagandha
Dehydrated Sprouts and Indian Ready-made Meals are removed
Vanilla Beans and Saffron are removed
